newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Aware initiated as a hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Aware initiated as a hold.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth Friday initiated coverage of Aware Inc, a developer of Assymetric Digital Subscriber Line (ADSL) Internet access technology, with a rating of hold.

-- Analyst Charles Pluckhahn said while Aware's Discrete Wavelet Multitone technology has not been standardized, it is compatible with the Discrete Multitone (DMT) standard accepted the American National Standards Institute.

-- Pluckhahn said Aware can "ride a wave of pro-DMT sentiment among carriers that may want an alternative to the standardized technology." He added it it too early to judge which, if any, of the DMT variants will ultimately win out.
-- Aware develops telecommunications equipment based on high-speed ADSL technology.
